meta.title: Workspace references
meta.description: Reference workspaces, sessions and files by stable ID, with explicit human-only multi-session routing.

reviewHint: Check every destination before confirming. New routes create blank sessions only after confirmation.
receiptHint: Accepted means queued, not completed. Partial or unknown blocks are not automatically retried.
rawDraftRequired: Routing is unavailable because the input surface did not preserve the untrimmed draft. No message was sent.
invalidRoute: Invalid routing header. No message was sent.
routeTargetUnavailable: Check the routing destination and try again.
workspaceMissing: The specified workspace was not found.
sessionMissing: The specified session was not found in this workspace.
workspaceAmbiguous: The workspace name is ambiguous. Choose a workspace from autocomplete.
sessionAmbiguous: Sessions in this workspace share that name. Choose a session from autocomplete.
sessionUnavailable: The session list is temporarily unavailable.
routeAttachments: Routing attachments is not supported. Remove attachments or send them directly in the target session.
routeFailed: Routing did not complete. Inspect these receipts before retrying; accepted blocks must not be sent again.
